method: ServiceCutter official Chinese Whispers + Java AST bridge
mapping_assumptions: Native use-case responsibilities map directly to Java @Service proxy IDs, then to that class public methods.
A class remains one input unit, matching MicroMiner/MonoEmbed class granularity.
Use-case proxies lacking native responsibility fall back to the largest nanoentity cluster; their list is explicit.
Entity ownership uses the majority of its actual fields; no native field partition is changed.
